Full skill text at 7★
Grants all allies [Frenzied Blade] (increases ATK by 40%) for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 750% ATK [Poison] DMG to all enemies. Grants self [Golden Edict] (when successfully inflicting a Control effect on a non-Boss unit or causing it to skip a turn, increases self's Turn Meter by 20%; can trigger up to 1 time before self's turn) for 4 turns. After casting this skill, the owner gains an extra turn, and the CD of this skill is reduced by 1 turn. After casting this skill, increases all allies' DMG dealt to Bosses by 0.5%; for each ally with the [Poison] tag deployed, additionally increases the DMG bonus by 0.1%, up to 10 layers. After casting this skill, additionally increases all allies' Skill DMG by 5% and Mastery by 5% until the end of battle, up to 40 times. At the beginning of battle, automatically casts this skill once. This cast does not grant an extra turn. When causing an enemy to skip their turns, [Golden Edict] can trigger 1 additional time, for a total of up to 2 triggers before self acts. After [Golden Edict] has triggered 2 times in total, each time self casts a skill during the next 2 turns, additionally causes the enemy with the highest SPD to immediately take 1 turn and skip 1 turn. This can trigger up to 2 times before self's turn. Skipping turn this time does not trigger [Golden Edict]. This additional immediate-turn and turn-skipping effect does not apply if the selected target is a Boss.
Source: game files.

Effects

  • [Frenzied Blade] — Increases ATK by a certain amount.
  • [Golden Edict] — When successfully inflicting a Control effect on a non-Boss unit or causing them to skip a turn, increases self's Turn Meter by a certain amount.
  • [Poison] — Each layer of Poison reduces the DMG dealt by the owner by 1.5%, stackable up to 10 layers. This effect is doubled when Poison stacks more than 5 layers. Meanwhile, the owner takes DMG by 100% of the inflictor's ATK each turn before action. Poison DMG ignores DEF and cannot trigger Crit, Leech and DMG Reflect effects.
